ingredients.title: Dough
items: 3 cups whole wheat flour (more as needed)

instructions.title: Dough
items: In mixing bowl, mix together salt, honey, warm milk, oil and eggs.
Add wheat gluten and flaxseed to the mixture and beat.
Add yeast mixture and then add flour, 1/2 cup at a time, and knead until soft.
Put into greased bowl and spread oil on top. Cover and let rise about an hour.
Punch down, shape into loaves, and let rise in pans about 1/2 hour.
